source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: The defending player works through three steps. 1) Split the target unit’s models into groups, repeating as needed: each CHARACTER model forms its own group, and every other model shares a group with the models whose W, Sv and InSv all match its own. 2) Fix an allocation order for the groups, obeying all of these: a non-CHARACTER group with a wounded model goes first; no CHARACTER group may come before any non-CHARACTER group; and CHARACTER groups with a wounded model come before CHARACTER groups without one. 3) Roll one D6 as a save roll for every attack that wounded the unit. “Saving throw” is another name for a save roll. If the values of hit or wound rolls change some attacks, split those attacks into pools that share an identical new profile; the active player picks which pool goes through the save and damage steps first, then picks each next pool in turn until all are resolved.
